briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: Multiple investigations are underway in Minnesota, including a probe into alleged Medicaid fraud and a separate investigation into the closure of St. Cloud's Star Autism Center amid a fraud scandal. The Minnesota Department of Human Services has suspended the center's license, and HHS has warned that Minnesota may have to repay millions for withholding child care program records. These developments suggest potential wrongdoing and warrant further investigation into the center's activities and possible connections to other entities or individuals. The agency will continue to track these cases and explore potential connections between entities and programs.
